description: Forge fantasy weapon names with legendary epithets — 'Dawnbreaker, Blade of the Fallen King'.

faqs.a: Swords, axes, bows, daggers, hammers, staves, and spears — each with fitting name parts.
Every weapon gets an epithet like 'of the Fallen King' or 'the Oathkeeper'.
8 weapons per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any weapon to copy its full name.

howto: Click any weapon to copy it.
title: Weapon Name Generator
